svg.text: Composable Function Transformations + XLA - google/jax - Foundation of JAX AI Stack
L3 - Tracing, jaxpr IR & jax.lax Primitives
Tracer objects wrap args - record shape/dtype ops
Static ops: Python compile-time - Dynamic: XLA runtime
Python side-effects invisible to jaxpr (still run at trace)
Typed functional ANF - vars, constvars, eqns, sub-jaxprs
Higher-order: pjit, cond, while_loop, scan, pallas_call
Transformations trace-specialize then interpret with rules
grad/vmap may apply incrementally during tracing
Strict lower-level API - all ops map to XLA primitives
jax.numpy is high-level wrapper over lax + XLA
Functional purity enables jit + AD + vmap composition on arbitrary pytree structures
First call traces - subsequent calls reuse compiled XLA executable
Step 1: Python fn called - Tracers wrap concrete args (shape/dtype/sharding)
Step 2: Build ClosedJaxpr - record jax.lax primitive eqns in ANF
Step 3: Lower to StableHLO/HLO - GSPMD/Shardy auto-partition if sharded
Step 4: XLA compile - fusion + layout + collectives - PjRT executable
Step 5: Async dispatch to devices - block_until_ready() for sync - cache reuse
grad(jit(f)) and vmap(jit(f)) compose - transformations nest via trace rules
in_shardings/out_shardings/donate_argnums control memory and SPMD layout
Pallas Kernels + JAX AI Stack Ecosystem
Custom kernels when XLA is insufficient - same JAX transforms apply
shard_map = manual SPMD escape hatch - jit = automatic GSPMD partition
L6 - Hardware Abstraction via PjRT + OpenXLA
Same Python code - TPU / GPU(CUDA/ROCm) / CPU - Pathways multi-slice - foundation of modern ML infra
Init path: import jax - discover devices via PjRT - create Mesh - define sharded pytrees
Step path: transform(fn) - trace to jaxpr - XLA compile - async execute - compose grad/vmap/jit
Sources: docs.jax.dev - jaxpr/key-concepts/jit/shard_map/pallas - OpenXLA/GSPMD - Cloud TPU JAX AI stack
